_note: Merrin & Sallow Architects office kit (ca12 build sheet living_office_build/CA12_BUILD.md part 1). Tiles are px/32 on the 10x10 studio map room_aw_merrin_sallow. Walk tiles and the PC position are first-pass dressing guesses, to be checked live (sheet proof 4): east door (8.5,2.5) from doors.js placeEastDoorSingle; step-in (6.5,4.5) in both set pieces (the engine counts a walk as arrived within 1 tile, npc-behavior.js:1432-1445, so every walker stops up to 1 tile short of its target; Camila is hidden about 1 tile from the east door tile, which was judged close enough to read as the door); J2 sends Julian to (7.0,5.5), more than 1.5 tiles from his rest spot (6.9,8.1); desks (2.5,5.0); beside-desks (3.5,5.0); Lorna post (5.5,3.8); Julian home (6,8); Thandiwe's PC approach cell (3.9,6.0); PC (3.28125,6.96875) on the table top, 28x23 at px (105,223) above the table front edge (246), with elevation 24.2 so it draws over the conference table sprite (depth 270.5) and its table items; the journal stack placeholder is claimed by kit_ca12_journals and moved 7 px left (86 to 79) so the PC fits between it and the plans roll without overlap. The visitor uses her own camila_ospina atlas, talk and visemes sheets (bust b01, talk t02).

ca04_defend_react._note: D280: the ca04 defend twin's after-sort colleague beat (pattern of ca05_defend_react). The speaker says one line aloud when the defend set finishes (kit_defend_done -> true); delayMs lets the delayed-mapping runner wait for the kiosk to close. targetKnot (no literal bark) makes the engine speak ca04_react's first line via TTS; the knot branches on kit_key_caught and is true on every path. The twin has no host bark, so nothing overlaps. Twin only; the full shell is untouched.

Wrong or no answer: Delphine says the new Catherine Merrin account has liked the photo and asked to connect (row 8), and the PC shows the photo live (moved). Right answer (crop): done after 4 s. ca18_reset_password._note: ca18 colleague request (WAVE6_BUILD.md s6, D259 wording). Lorna has reset her password after the morning's spray and typed her old one with the season moved on. The room teaches NCSC-style advice: do not just tweak the old password, make a new one (three random words). Wrong or no answer: Ama (host, row 8) says this morning's attackers have already guessed the new password and to turn down sign-in prompts nobody started, and the PC shows Fenlow's lock notice (moved).
